name: Birgitta Asante-Papadopoulos
location: Geartown, corner of Ironvein Passage and the Sixth Lateral, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Birgitta is a wide-shouldered woman with close-cropped silver-streaked hair and dark amber skin mapped with decades of small burn scars from broth splatter. Her left eye has been replaced with a simple optical implant — utilitarian amber glass, no cosmetic flourish — and she keeps a row of mismatched E.L.F. shrine tokens zip-tied to the roof of her cart's canopy: a cracked tablet, a dead phone, a bent transit card. She believes the E.L.F. that lives in her cart's heating element blesses the broth. She has never given it a name because she says that would be presumptuous.

She is brisk, efficient, and faintly terrifying to newcomers who don't know how to order. Her menu is three items and she will not deviate. She has been at the same corner for nineteen years and knows every shift-change, every backroom deal, and every failing marriage in a four-block radius. She does not gossip. She observes. She is saving for something she will not discuss.

core_fears: Being forced to move her cart — losing the one fixed thing in her life
Dying before she finishes what she started
core_desires: To buy out the lease on a small building and open a real restaurant before she's sixty
To know her daughter is safe, wherever she is
coping_mechanisms: Ritual �� the same prep sequence every morning, never varying
Redirecting emotional energy into physical labor
blind_spots: She assumes people who are kind to her want something
She underestimates how much younger workers look up to her
psychology.secret: She has been quietly funneling a portion of her daily earnings into an anonymous account that she sends to her estranged daughter in Hamtramck Enclave. She has not spoken to her daughter in eleven years. She does not know if the daughter checks it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Short sentences. No filler. Technical when it comes to food. Surprisingly precise vocabulary for a street vendor — she reads constantly.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flat, even, unhurried. Does not raise her voice.
verbal_tics: Long pauses before answering personal questions
example_lines: 'You want the bone or the clear. That's the choice. You've had ten seconds.'
'I've seen that man eat here every Tuesday for six years. Last week he didn't come. I'm telling you so someone knows.'

story_hooks: A regular customer hasn't shown up in two weeks. She noticed before anyone else did and she wants someone to check.
She's being pressured by a Ferrogate Transit sub-contractor to relocate her cart to clear the corner for a new maintenance depot. She refuses. Things are escalating.
She received a data packet in her anonymous account — not money, but a message. She doesn't know who sent it or what it means.
narrative_function: Information source, local anchor, atmospheric color. She's seen everything and will share exactly as much as she decides you've earned. Quest giver for neighborhood-level problems.
augmentations: Basic optical implant (left eye, utilitarian grade). No geneware. Hands show subdermal grip-texture from an old work mod, mostly faded.
daily_life: She arrives at her corner at 04:30 to start the broth and leaves at 14:00 exactly, regardless of the queue. She spends her afternoons doing accounts and repairing her cart's aging heating coils herself.

decision_rules: Never extend credit to anyone she doesn't personally know
Don't get involved in other people's violence unless it happens at her cart
Maintain the routine no matter what — the routine is load-bearing
escalation_ladder: Address it once, directly, without emotion
Remove herself from the situation entirely — pack up and leave

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Transactional and neutral. Efficient. Not unkind but not warm.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Still short on words but attentive in practical ways — remembering what people like, having it ready.

stress_responses.high: Shuts the cart early and walks for hours without destination

contradictions: Claims not to care about people but has memorized the schedules and habits of dozens of regulars
Says she's saving for herself but the math doesn't add up if you pay attention
habits: Wipes down the counter between every customer even when it doesn't need it
Prays silently to the cart's E.L.F. every morning before first service — a murmured sequence in a mix of Greek and Twi she won't translate
breaking_points: Someone threatening a regular she's grown fond of
Learning her daughter is in danger

timeline.event: Born in Hamtramck Enclave to a Ghanaian-descended father and a Greek-descended mother
Estrangement from daughter following an undisclosed conflict
Sets up cart at current corner in Geartown
Begins anonymous financial transfers to daughter's account
